Modern Component Library

// Enhanced button animations with shimmer effects
.btn {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  
  &::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), transparent);
    transition: left var(--transition-slow);
  }
  
  &:hover::before {

  }
}
